name: Staffs & Worcs. & Shropshire Union Canal
notes: Linear area on the Staffordshire and Worcestershire Canal and the Shropshire Union Canal in the north-west of the city. Designation date from the council's Historic Environment Record layer (StatusDate, record DBL970). The council publishes no appraisal for this area (its table says 'No'). It is a separate designation from the Staffordshire and Worcestershire Canal conservation areas of the neighbouring districts; no PDP geometry covers it. Boundary from City of Wolverhampton Council ArcGIS layer 'ConservationAreas', feature 'Staffs/Worcs & Shropshire Union Canal Conservation Area': https://maps.wolverhampton.gov.uk/arcgis/rest/services/ConservationAreas/FeatureServer/0
